test_cases.title: Checkout purchase without using an account
steps: Verify that the order is placed successfully
test_cases.expected_result: The order is placed successfully without requiring a user account.

test_cases.title: Apply a promotional code at checkout
steps: Enter a valid promotional code in the designated field
Verify that the discount is applied to the order total
test_cases.expected_result: The discount is applied to the order total when a valid promotional code is entered.

test_cases.title: Checkout form guides the user correct missing/wrong information
steps: Fill the required fields in the checkout form with incorrect or missing information
Verify that the form highlights the incorrect or missing fields and provides guidance to correct them
test_cases.expected_result: The form highlights the incorrect or missing fields and provides guidance to correct them.
